segments.tr: لذا يتم الاكتتاب في القرض مقابل **التدفق النقدي المتوقع للمشروع نفسه**، وعادة ما يتم الاحتفاظ به في كيان ذي غرض خاص لا يملك أي شيء آخر.

segments.src: Money is released in draws as construction hits milestones, not in one lump sum.
segments.tr: يتم صرف الأموال على دفعات مع وصول البناء إلى مراحل معينة، وليس في مبلغ مقطوع واحد.

segments.src: It's often non-recourse or limited-recourse — if the project fails, the lender takes the project, not the developer's other assets.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يكون القرض بدون حق رجوع أو بحق رجوع محدود — إذا فشل المشروع، يأخذ المُقرض المشروع، وليس أصول المطور الأخرى.

segments.src: That's why lenders demand real equity underneath (commonly 30–40% of total cost) and a coverage cushion:
segments.tr: لهذا السبب يطالب المُقرضون بأسهم حقيقية (عادة 30-40% من التكلفة الإجمالية) ووسادة تغطية:

segments.src: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service
segments.tr: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service

segments.src: Most lenders want DSCR of at least 1.20–1.25 once the building is leased up.
segments.tr: يريد معظم المُقرضين نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR) لا تقل عن 1.20–1.25 بمجرد تأجير المبنى.

segments.src: Below 1.0 the building doesn't cover its own loan.
segments.tr: أقل من 1.0، لا يغطي المبنى قرضه الخاص.

segments.src: REITs (public market level).** A real estate investment trust owns income-producing property (an *equity REIT*) or property loans (a *mortgage REIT*), and sells shares of itself.
segments.tr: صناديق الاستثمار العقاري (REITs) (على مستوى السوق العام).** يمتلك صندوق الاستثمار العقاري عقارات مدرة للدخل (*صندوق استثمار عقاري للأسهم*) أو قروض عقارية (*صندوق استثمار عقاري للرهن العقاري*)، ويبيع أسهماً لنفسه.

segments.src: To keep REIT tax status it must distribute at least **90% of taxable income** to shareholders, hold at least 75% of assets in real estate-type assets, and draw at least 75% of gross income from rents, mortgage interest, and property sales.
segments.tr: للحفاظ على الوضع الضريبي لصندوق الاستثمار العقاري، يجب عليه توزيع ما لا يقل عن **90% من الدخل الخاضع للضريبة** على المساهمين، والاحتفاظ بما لا يقل عن 75% من الأصول في أصول من نوع العقارات، والحصول على ما لا يقل عن 75% من إجمالي الدخل من الإيجارات، وفوائد الرهن العقاري، ومبيعات العقارات.

segments.src: In exchange, it avoids corporate-level tax on distributed income.
segments.tr: في المقابل، يتجنب الصندوق ضريبة مستوى الشركات على الدخل الموزع.

segments.src: Practical translation: high dividend payout, low retained earnings, and dividends that are generally taxed as **ordinary income** rather than at qualified-dividend rates.
segments.tr: الترجمة العملية: توزيعات أرباح عالية، أرباح محتجزة منخفضة، وتوزيعات أرباح تخضع عموماً للضريبة كـ **دخل عادي** بدلاً من معدلات توزيعات الأرباح المؤهلة.

segments.src: The thread running through all three is **leverage** — and leverage cuts both directions, which most people only half-remember.
segments.tr: الخيط المشترك بين الثلاثة هو **الرافعة المالية** — والرافعة المالية تعمل في كلا الاتجاهين، وهو ما يتذكره معظم الناس بشكل ناقص فقط.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Say you're buying a $350,000 house in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: لنفترض أنك تشتري منزلاً بقيمة 350,000 دولار في كولومبوس، أوهايو.

segments.src: You put 20% down ($70,000) and borrow $280,000 on a 30-year fixed.
segments.tr: تدفع 20% كدفعة أولى (70,000 دولار) وتقترض 280,000 دولار بقرض ثابت لمدة 30 عاماً.

segments.src: At 6.5%, principal and interest run about **$1,770 a month** — before taxes, insurance, and any HOA.
segments.tr: بفائدة 6.5%، يبلغ أصل القرض والفائدة حوالي **1,770 دولاراً شهرياً** — قبل الضرائب والتأمين وأي رسوم جمعية ملاك (HOA).

segments.src: Over the full 30 years you'd pay roughly **$357,000 in interest**, more than the amount you borrowed.
segments.tr: على مدار 30 عاماً كاملة، ستدفع ما يقرب من **357,000 دولار كفوائد**، وهو أكثر من المبلغ الذي اقترضته.

segments.src: That's the price of not waiting 15 years to save cash.
segments.tr: هذا هو ثمن عدم الانتظار 15 عاماً لتوفير المال.

segments.src: Now the leverage math.
segments.tr: الآن رياضيات الرافعة المالية.

segments.src: Your $70,000 controls a $350,000 asset — 5x.
segments.tr: مبلغ الـ 70,000 دولار الخاص بك يتحكم في أصل بقيمة 350,000 دولار — أي 5 أضعاف.

segments.src: If the house appreciates 10% to $385,000, your equity goes from $70,000 to $105,000: a **50% gain**.
segments.tr: إذا ارتفعت قيمة المنزل بنسبة 10% لتصل إلى 385,000 دولار، فإن حقوق ملكيتك ترتفع من 70,000 دولار إلى 105,000 دولار: أي **مكسب بنسبة 50%**.

segments.src: If it drops 10% to $315,000, your equity falls to $35,000: a **50% loss**.
segments.tr: إذا انخفضت بنسبة 10% لتصل إلى 315,000 دولار، تنخفض حقوق ملكيتك إلى 35,000 دولار: أي **خسارة بنسبة 50%**.

segments.src: Same 10% move, five times the impact on your money.
segments.tr: نفس التحرك بنسبة 10%، خمسة أضعاف التأثير على أموالك.

segments.src: Nothing about the house changed; the loan did that.
segments.tr: لم يتغير شيء في المنزل؛ القرض هو من فعل ذلك.

segments.src: Two blocks away, a developer is putting up a 200-unit apartment building.
segments.tr: على بعد مبنيين، يقوم مطور ببناء مبنى سكني مكون من 200 وحدة.

segments.src: Total cost: $60 million.
segments.tr: التكلفة الإجمالية: 60 مليون دولار.

segments.src: A bank lends $40 million (about 65% loan-to-cost), released in draws as the foundation, frame, and finishes get completed; the developer brings $20 million of equity and preferred capital.
segments.tr: يقرض أحد البنوك 40 مليون دولار (حوالي 65% من نسبة القرض إلى التكلفة)، يتم صرفها على دفعات مع اكتمال الأساس والهيكل والتشطيبات؛ ويجلب المطور 20 مليون دولار من الأسهم ورأس المال المفضل.

segments.src: Nobody's personal house backs this.
segments.tr: لا يوجد منزل شخصي لأحد يدعم هذا.

segments.src: When the building stabilizes and throws off, say, $3.9 million of net operating income against roughly $2.9 million of annual debt service, DSCR lands near 1.35 — comfortable.
segments.tr: عندما يستقر المبنى ويدر، لنقل، 3.9 مليون دولار من صافي دخل التشغيل مقابل حوالي 2.9 مليون دولار من خدمة الدين السنوية، تصل نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR) إلى حوالي 1.35 — وهو وضع مريح.

segments.src: At a 6% cap rate that NOI values the building around $65 million, so a $60 million cost turns into roughly $5 million of gain on $20 million of equity.
segments.tr: بمعدل رسملة 6%، يقيم صافي دخل التشغيل هذا المبنى بحوالي 65 مليون دولار، لذا تتحول تكلفة 60 مليون دولار إلى ربح يقارب 5 ملايين دولار على 20 مليون دولار من الأسهم.

segments.src: Illustrative, not typical: a nine-month construction delay, a rate move, or lease-up at 88% instead of 95% can erase that spread entirely.
segments.tr: هذا توضيحي وليس نموذجياً: تأخير في البناء لمدة تسعة أشهر، أو تغير في سعر الفائدة، أو نسبة تأجير 88% بدلاً من 95% يمكن أن يمحو هذا الفارق تماماً.

segments.src: And who buys that stabilized building?
segments.tr: ومن يشتري ذلك المبنى المستقر؟

segments.src: Often a REIT — one of the roughly 200 publicly traded U.S.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يكون صندوق استثمار عقاري (REIT) — واحد من حوالي 200 شركة متداولة علناً في الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: REITs listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq.
segments.tr: صناديق الاستثمار العقاري المدرجة في بورصة نيويورك وناسداك.

segments.src: Which means the same apartment complex you drive past is something you can own a sliver of from a brokerage account for the price of one share, collecting your cut of the rent as a quarterly dividend, without ever fixing a water heater.
segments.tr: مما يعني أن نفس المجمع السكني الذي تمر بجانبه هو شيء يمكنك امتلاك جزء صغير منه من حساب وساطة بسعر سهم واحد، وتحصيل حصتك من الإيجار كتوزيعات أرباح ربع سنوية، دون الحاجة إلى إصلاح سخان مياه أبداً.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## ملخص من 3 أسطر

segments.src: 1. A mortgage lends against an existing property and against **you** (LTV + DTI, usually with recourse); project finance lends against a **future building's cash flow**, held in its own entity, usually with limited recourse and a DSCR test.
segments.tr: 1. الرهن العقاري يقرض بضمان عقار موجود وبضمان **أنت** (نسبة القرض إلى القيمة + نسبة الدين إلى الدخل، عادة مع حق الرجوع)؛ تمويل المشاريع يقرض بضمان **التدفق النقدي لمبنى مستقبلي**، ويتم الاحتفاظ به في كيانه الخاص، وعادة مع حق رجوع محدود واختبار نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR).

segments.src: 2. Leverage multiplies percentage returns in both directions — 20% down means a 10% price move becomes a 50% move in your equity.
segments.tr: 2. الرافعة المالية تضاعف العوائد بالنسبة المئوية في كلا الاتجاهين — دفعة أولى بنسبة 20% تعني أن تحرك السعر بنسبة 10% يصبح تحركاً بنسبة 50% في حقوق ملكيتك.

segments.src: 3. A REIT converts illiquid buildings into tradable shares; the 90% distribution requirement is why REITs pay big dividends and why those dividends are generally taxed as ordinary income.
segments.tr: 3. يحول صندوق الاستثمار العقاري (REIT) المباني غير السائلة إلى أسهم قابلة للتداول؛ شرط التوزيع بنسبة 90% هو السبب في أن صناديق الاستثمار العقاري تدفع توزيعات أرباح كبيرة ولماذا تخضع هذه التوزيعات عموماً للضريبة كدخل عادي.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: **1.** You buy a $400,000 property with a $320,000 loan.
segments.tr: **1.** تشتري عقاراً بقيمة 400,000 دولار بقرض قدره 320,000 دولار.

segments.src: What is the LTV, and would you typically owe PMI on a conventional loan?
segments.tr: ما هي نسبة القرض إلى القيمة (LTV)، وهل ستدين عادةً بتأمين رهن عقاري خاص (PMI) في قرض تقليدي؟

segments.src: (a) 80%, no PMI   (b) 80%, PMI required   (c) 125%, no PMI   (d) 20%, PMI required
segments.tr: (أ) 80%، لا يوجد PMI   (ب) 80%، مطلوب PMI   (ج) 125%، لا يوجد PMI   (د) 20%، مطلوب PMI

segments.src: True or False:** A REIT must distribute at least 90% of its taxable income to shareholders to maintain REIT tax status.
segments.tr: صح أم خطأ:** يجب على صندوق الاستثمار العقاري (REIT) توزيع ما لا يقل عن 90% من دخله الخاضع للضريبة على المساهمين للحفاظ على الوضع الضريبي لصندوق الاستثمار العقاري.

segments.src: **3.** A project has $2.4 million in net operating income and $2.0 million in annual debt service.
segments.tr: **3.** مشروع لديه 2.4 مليون دولار من صافي دخل التشغيل و2.0 مليون دولار من خدمة الدين السنوية.

segments.src: Which statement is correct?
segments.tr: أي عبارة صحيحة؟

segments.src: (a) DSCR is 0.83 — the project cannot cover its debt
segments.tr: (أ) نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR) هي 0.83 — المشروع لا يمكنه تغطية ديونه

segments.src: (b) DSCR is 1.20 — the project covers its debt with a 20% cushion
segments.tr: (ب) نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR) هي 1.20 — المشروع يغطي ديونه بـ 20% كاحتياطي

segments.src: (c) DSCR is 4.4 — this is the cap rate
segments.tr: (ج) نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR) هي 4.4 — هذا هو معدل الرسملة

segments.src: (d) DSCR cannot be calculated without the purchase price
segments.tr: (د) لا يمكن حساب نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين (DSCR) بدون سعر الشراء

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value)** — Loan amount divided by property value; the lender's primary measure of collateral cushion.
segments.tr: - **LTV (نسبة القرض إلى القيمة)** — مبلغ القرض مقسوماً على قيمة العقار؛ المقياس الأساسي للمُقرض لوسادة الضمانات.

segments.src: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — Net operating income divided by annual debt service; below 1.0 the property can't pay its own loan.
segments.tr: - **DSCR (نسبة تغطية خدمة الدين)** — صافي دخل التشغيل مقسوماً على خدمة الدين السنوية؛ أقل من 1.0 لا يمكن للعقار دفع قرضه الخاص.

segments.src: - **Non-recourse loan** — A loan where the lender's remedy on default is limited to the pledged property, not the borrower's other assets.
segments.tr: - **قرض بدون حق رجوع** — قرض يكون فيه تعويض المُقرض عند التخلف عن السداد مقتصرًا على العقار المرهون، وليس أصول المقترض الأخرى.

segments.src: - **Takeout (permanent) loan** — Long-term financing that replaces a short-term construction loan once the building is completed and leased.
segments.tr: - **قرض التمويل الدائم (Takeout loan)** — تمويل طويل الأجل يحل محل قرض بناء قصير الأجل بمجرد اكتمال المبنى وتأجيره.

segments.src: - **Cap rate** — Net operating income divided by property price; a rough yield measure used to value income property (`Cap rate = NOI / price`).
segments.tr: - **معدل الرسملة (Cap rate)** — صافي دخل التشغيل مقسوماً على سعر العقار؛ مقياس عائد تقريبي يستخدم لتقييم العقارات المدرة للدخل (`معدل الرسملة = صافي دخل التشغيل / السعر`).

segments.src: - **REIT** — A company owning income-producing real estate or real estate debt that avoids corporate-level tax by distributing at least 90% of taxable income.
segments.tr: - **REIT (صندوق الاستثمار العقاري)** — شركة تمتلك عقارات مدرة للدخل أو ديوناً عقارية تتجنب ضريبة مستوى الشركات عن طريق توزيع ما لا يقل عن 90% من الدخل الخاضع للضريبة.

segments.src: *Answers: **1.
segments.tr: *الإجابات: **1.

segments.src: (a)** — $320,000 / $400,000 = 80% LTV, which is exactly the conventional threshold, so PMI is generally not required; PMI kicks in above 80% LTV (less than 20% down).
segments.tr: (أ)** — 320,000 دولار / 400,000 دولار = 80% LTV، وهي بالضبط العتبة التقليدية، لذا فإن PMI غير مطلوب عموماً؛ يبدأ PMI في الظهور فوق 80% LTV (أقل من 20% دفعة أولى).

segments.src: True** — the 90% distribution requirement is a core REIT qualification test, alongside the 75% asset and 75% income tests.
segments.tr: صح** — شرط التوزيع بنسبة 90% هو اختبار تأهيل أساسي لصندوق الاستثمار العقاري، إلى جانب اختبارات الأصول بنسبة 75% والدخل بنسبة 75%.

segments.src: (b)** — $2.4M / $2.0M = 1.20 DSCR, meaning income exceeds debt payments by 20%; most lenders set a floor around 1.20–1.25.
segments.tr: (ب)** — 2.4 مليون دولار / 2.0 مليون دولار = 1.20 DSCR، مما يعني أن الدخل يتجاوز مدفوعات الدين بنسبة 20%؛ يحدد معظم المُقرضين حداً أدنى يتراوح بين 1.20–1.25.

segments.src: Cap rate is a separate calculation and needs the price.*
segments.tr: معدل الرسملة هو حساب منفصل ويحتاج إلى السعر.*

fr.title: [Immobilier 101 #11] Presque personne ne paie comptant : les trois façons de financer l'immobilier

segments.src: > Real estate runs on borrowed money — a mortgage buys the house you live in, project finance builds the tower downtown, and a REIT lets you own a slice of both for the price of one share.
segments.tr: > L'immobilier fonctionne grâce à l'argent emprunté — un prêt hypothécaire achète la maison dans laquelle vous vivez, le financement de projet construit la tour au centre-ville, et une SIIC (REIT) vous permet de posséder une part des deux pour le prix d'une seule action.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Real estate is expensive and mostly illiquid, so almost every deal — from a starter home to a $400 million office tower — is a financing deal wearing a building costume.
segments.tr: L'immobilier est coûteux et largement illiquide, donc presque chaque transaction — d'une première maison à une tour de bureaux de 400 millions de dollars — est une opération de financement déguisée en bâtiment.

segments.src: There are three main channels, and they differ mainly in **what the lender is actually betting on**.
segments.tr: Il existe trois canaux principaux, et ils diffèrent principalement par **ce sur quoi le prêteur parie réellement**.

segments.src: The mortgage (household level).** You borrow against a property that already exists.
segments.tr: Le prêt hypothécaire (niveau ménage).** Vous empruntez sur une propriété qui existe déjà.

segments.src: The lender looks at two things: the collateral and you.
segments.tr: Le prêteur examine deux choses : la garantie et vous.

segments.src: LTV = loan amount / property value
segments.tr: LTV = loan amount / property value

segments.src: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income
segments.tr: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income

segments.src: A conventional loan typically wants LTV at or below 80% (that's a 20% down payment) and DTI in the low-to-mid 40s, sometimes up to 50% with strong credit and reserves.
segments.tr: Un prêt conventionnel exige généralement un ratio prêt-valeur (LTV) égal ou inférieur à 80 % (soit un apport de 20 %) et un ratio d'endettement (DTI) situé dans la fourchette basse à moyenne de 40 %, parfois jusqu'à 50 % avec un bon crédit et des réserves.

segments.src: Go above 80% LTV and you'll usually pay private mortgage insurance (PMI) until you get back down to 80%.
segments.tr: Si vous dépassez 80 % de LTV, vous paierez généralement une assurance prêt hypothécaire privée (PMI) jusqu'à ce que vous redescendiez à 80 %.

segments.src: The key structural fact: it's **recourse to you**.
segments.tr: Le fait structurel clé : il s'agit d'un **recours contre vous**.

segments.src: Miss payments and the lender can foreclose on the house *and*, in many states, come after you for the shortfall.
segments.tr: Si vous manquez des paiements, le prêteur peut saisir la maison *et*, dans de nombreux États, se retourner contre vous pour le solde impayé.

segments.src: Project finance / construction lending (development level).** A developer building something that doesn't exist yet can't pledge a finished building.
segments.tr: Financement de projet / prêt à la construction (niveau développement).** Un promoteur qui construit quelque chose qui n'existe pas encore ne peut pas mettre en gage un bâtiment fini.

segments.src: So the loan is underwritten against the **project's own projected cash flow**, and it's typically held in a single-purpose entity that owns nothing else.
segments.tr: Le prêt est donc souscrit sur la base des **flux de trésorerie projetés du projet lui-même**, et il est généralement détenu dans une entité à vocation unique qui ne possède rien d'autre.

segments.src: Money is released in draws as construction hits milestones, not in one lump sum.
segments.tr: L'argent est débloqué par tranches au fur et à mesure que la construction atteint des étapes clés, et non en une seule somme forfaitaire.

segments.src: It's often non-recourse or limited-recourse — if the project fails, the lender takes the project, not the developer's other assets.
segments.tr: Il s'agit souvent d'un prêt sans recours ou à recours limité — si le projet échoue, le prêteur saisit le projet, pas les autres actifs du promoteur.

segments.src: That's why lenders demand real equity underneath (commonly 30–40% of total cost) and a coverage cushion:
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les prêteurs exigent des fonds propres réels (généralement 30 à 40 % du coût total) et une marge de sécurité :

segments.src: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service
segments.tr: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service

segments.src: Most lenders want DSCR of at least 1.20–1.25 once the building is leased up.
segments.tr: La plupart des prêteurs exigent un DSCR d'au moins 1,20 à 1,25 une fois le bâtiment loué.

segments.src: Below 1.0 the building doesn't cover its own loan.
segments.tr: En dessous de 1,0, le bâtiment ne couvre pas son propre prêt.

segments.src: REITs (public market level).** A real estate investment trust owns income-producing property (an *equity REIT*) or property loans (a *mortgage REIT*), and sells shares of itself.
segments.tr: SIIC / REIT (niveau marché public).** Une société d'investissement immobilier (REIT) possède des propriétés génératrices de revenus (une *equity REIT*) ou des prêts immobiliers (une *mortgage REIT*), et vend ses propres actions.

segments.src: To keep REIT tax status it must distribute at least **90% of taxable income** to shareholders, hold at least 75% of assets in real estate-type assets, and draw at least 75% of gross income from rents, mortgage interest, and property sales.
segments.tr: Pour conserver le statut fiscal de REIT, elle doit distribuer au moins **90 % de son revenu imposable** aux actionnaires, détenir au moins 75 % de ses actifs sous forme d'actifs immobiliers, et tirer au moins 75 % de son revenu brut des loyers, des intérêts hypothécaires et des ventes de propriétés.

segments.src: In exchange, it avoids corporate-level tax on distributed income.
segments.tr: En échange, elle évite l'impôt au niveau de l'entreprise sur les revenus distribués.

segments.src: Practical translation: high dividend payout, low retained earnings, and dividends that are generally taxed as **ordinary income** rather than at qualified-dividend rates.
segments.tr: Traduction pratique : versement de dividendes élevé, faibles bénéfices non répartis, et des dividendes qui sont généralement imposés comme un **revenu ordinaire** plutôt qu'aux taux des dividendes qualifiés.

segments.src: The thread running through all three is **leverage** — and leverage cuts both directions, which most people only half-remember.
segments.tr: Le fil conducteur entre ces trois méthodes est l'**effet de levier** — et l'effet de levier fonctionne dans les deux sens, ce que la plupart des gens n'oublient qu'à moitié.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Say you're buying a $350,000 house in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: Disons que vous achetez une maison de 350 000 $ à Columbus, dans l'Ohio.

segments.src: You put 20% down ($70,000) and borrow $280,000 on a 30-year fixed.
segments.tr: Vous versez 20 % d'apport (70 000 $) et empruntez 280 000 $ sur un prêt à taux fixe de 30 ans.

segments.src: At 6.5%, principal and interest run about **$1,770 a month** — before taxes, insurance, and any HOA.
segments.tr: À 6,5 %, le principal et les intérêts s'élèvent à environ **1 770 $ par mois** — avant les taxes, l'assurance et les éventuelles charges de copropriété (HOA).

segments.src: Over the full 30 years you'd pay roughly **$357,000 in interest**, more than the amount you borrowed.
segments.tr: Sur les 30 années complètes, vous paierez environ **357 000 $ d'intérêts**, soit plus que le montant emprunté.

segments.src: That's the price of not waiting 15 years to save cash.
segments.tr: C'est le prix à payer pour ne pas attendre 15 ans pour économiser l'argent comptant.

segments.src: Now the leverage math.
segments.tr: Maintenant, le calcul de l'effet de levier.

segments.src: Your $70,000 controls a $350,000 asset — 5x.
segments.tr: Vos 70 000 $ contrôlent un actif de 350 000 $ — soit 5x.

segments.src: If the house appreciates 10% to $385,000, your equity goes from $70,000 to $105,000: a **50% gain**.
segments.tr: Si la maison s'apprécie de 10 % pour atteindre 385 000 $, vos capitaux propres passent de 70 000 $ à 105 000 $ : un **gain de 50 %**.

segments.src: If it drops 10% to $315,000, your equity falls to $35,000: a **50% loss**.
segments.tr: Si elle baisse de 10 % à 315 000 $, vos capitaux propres tombent à 35 000 $ : une **perte de 50 %**.

segments.src: Same 10% move, five times the impact on your money.
segments.tr: Même mouvement de 10 %, cinq fois l'impact sur votre argent.

segments.src: Nothing about the house changed; the loan did that.
segments.tr: Rien n'a changé concernant la maison ; c'est le prêt qui a fait cela.

segments.src: Total cost: $60 million.
segments.tr: Coût total : 60 millions de dollars.

segments.src: A bank lends $40 million (about 65% loan-to-cost), released in draws as the foundation, frame, and finishes get completed; the developer brings $20 million of equity and preferred capital.
segments.tr: Une banque prête 40 millions de dollars (environ 65 % du ratio prêt-coût), débloqués par tranches au fur et à mesure que les fondations, la structure et les finitions sont terminées ; le promoteur apporte 20 millions de dollars de capitaux propres et de capital privilégié.

segments.src: Nobody's personal house backs this.
segments.tr: La maison personnelle de personne ne garantit cela.

segments.src: When the building stabilizes and throws off, say, $3.9 million of net operating income against roughly $2.9 million of annual debt service, DSCR lands near 1.35 — comfortable.

segments.src: Illustrative, not typical: a nine-month construction delay, a rate move, or lease-up at 88% instead of 95% can erase that spread entirely.
segments.tr: Illustratif, pas typique : un retard de construction de neuf mois, une variation des taux, ou une location à 88 % au lieu de 95 % peut effacer complètement cet écart.

segments.src: And who buys that stabilized building?
segments.tr: Et qui achète ce bâtiment stabilisé ?

segments.src: Often a REIT — one of the roughly 200 publicly traded U.S.
segments.tr: Souvent une SIIC (REIT) — l'une des quelque 200 sociétés cotées en bourse aux États-Unis.

segments.src: REITs listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq.
segments.tr: REIT cotées au NYSE et au Nasdaq.

segments.src: Which means the same apartment complex you drive past is something you can own a sliver of from a brokerage account for the price of one share, collecting your cut of the rent as a quarterly dividend, without ever fixing a water heater.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 lignes

segments.src: 1. A mortgage lends against an existing property and against **you** (LTV + DTI, usually with recourse); project finance lends against a **future building's cash flow**, held in its own entity, usually with limited recourse and a DSCR test.
segments.tr: 1. Un prêt hypothécaire prête sur une propriété existante et sur **vous** (LTV + DTI, généralement avec recours) ; le financement de projet prête sur les **flux de trésorerie d'un futur bâtiment**, détenu dans sa propre entité, généralement avec un recours limité et un test DSCR.

segments.src: 2. Leverage multiplies percentage returns in both directions — 20% down means a 10% price move becomes a 50% move in your equity.
segments.tr: 2. L'effet de levier multiplie les rendements en pourcentage dans les deux sens — 20 % d'apport signifie qu'un mouvement de prix de 10 % devient un mouvement de 50 % sur vos capitaux propres.

segments.src: 3. A REIT converts illiquid buildings into tradable shares; the 90% distribution requirement is why REITs pay big dividends and why those dividends are generally taxed as ordinary income.
segments.tr: 3. Une SIIC (REIT) convertit des bâtiments illiquides en actions négociables ; l'exigence de distribution de 90 % est la raison pour laquelle les REIT versent des dividendes importants et pourquoi ces dividendes sont généralement imposés comme un revenu ordinaire.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value)** — Loan amount divided by property value; the lender's primary measure of collateral cushion.
segments.tr: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value / Ratio prêt-valeur)** — Montant du prêt divisé par la valeur de la propriété ; la mesure principale du prêteur pour la marge de garantie.

segments.src: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — Net operating income divided by annual debt service; below 1.0 the property can't pay its own loan.
segments.tr: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio / Ratio de couverture du service de la dette)** — Revenu net d'exploitation divisé par le service de la dette annuel ; en dessous de 1,0, la propriété ne peut pas payer son propre prêt.

segments.src: - **Non-recourse loan** — A loan where the lender's remedy on default is limited to the pledged property, not the borrower's other assets.
segments.tr: - **Prêt sans recours (Non-recourse loan)** — Un prêt où le recours du prêteur en cas de défaut est limité à la propriété mise en gage, et non aux autres actifs de l'emprunteur.

segments.src: - **Takeout (permanent) loan** — Long-term financing that replaces a short-term construction loan once the building is completed and leased.
segments.tr: - **Prêt de sortie (Takeout loan / prêt permanent)** — Financement à long terme qui remplace un prêt de construction à court terme une fois le bâtiment terminé et loué.

segments.src: - **Cap rate** — Net operating income divided by property price; a rough yield measure used to value income property (`Cap rate = NOI / price`).
segments.tr: - **Taux de capitalisation (Cap rate)** — Revenu net d'exploitation divisé par le prix de la propriété ; une mesure de rendement approximative utilisée pour valoriser une propriété génératrice de revenus (`Cap rate = NOI / prix`).

segments.src: - **REIT** — A company owning income-producing real estate or real estate debt that avoids corporate-level tax by distributing at least 90% of taxable income.
segments.tr: - **SIIC / REIT** — Une société possédant de l'immobilier générant des revenus ou de la dette immobilière qui évite l'impôt au niveau de l'entreprise en distribuant au moins 90 % de son revenu imposable.

pt.title: [Imobiliário 101 #11] Quase ninguém paga à vista: As três formas de financiar um imóvel

segments.src: > Real estate runs on borrowed money — a mortgage buys the house you live in, project finance builds the tower downtown, and a REIT lets you own a slice of both for the price of one share.
segments.tr: > O mercado imobiliário funciona com dinheiro emprestado — uma hipoteca compra a casa onde você mora, o financiamento de projetos constrói o prédio no centro da cidade, e um REIT permite que você seja dono de uma fatia de ambos pelo preço de uma única ação.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de hoje

segments.src: Real estate is expensive and mostly illiquid, so almost every deal — from a starter home to a $400 million office tower — is a financing deal wearing a building costume.
segments.tr: Imóveis são caros e, em sua maioria, ilíquidos, então quase todo negócio — desde uma casa para iniciantes até uma torre de escritórios de $400 milhões — é um negócio de financiamento disfarçado de prédio.

segments.src: There are three main channels, and they differ mainly in **what the lender is actually betting on**.
segments.tr: Existem três canais principais, e eles diferem principalmente no **que o credor está realmente apostando**.

segments.src: The mortgage (household level).** You borrow against a property that already exists.
segments.tr: A hipoteca (nível doméstico).** Você toma emprestado usando como garantia uma propriedade que já existe.

segments.src: The lender looks at two things: the collateral and you.
segments.tr: O credor analisa duas coisas: a garantia e você.

segments.src: LTV = loan amount / property value
segments.tr: LTV = loan amount / property value

segments.src: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income
segments.tr: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income

segments.src: A conventional loan typically wants LTV at or below 80% (that's a 20% down payment) and DTI in the low-to-mid 40s, sometimes up to 50% with strong credit and reserves.
segments.tr: Um empréstimo convencional geralmente exige um LTV de 80% ou menos (isso é uma entrada de 20%) e um DTI na casa dos 40%, às vezes até 50% com bom crédito e reservas.

segments.src: Go above 80% LTV and you'll usually pay private mortgage insurance (PMI) until you get back down to 80%.
segments.tr: Se ultrapassar 80% de LTV, você geralmente pagará um seguro hipotecário privado (PMI) até que o valor volte a 80%.

segments.src: The key structural fact: it's **recourse to you**.
segments.tr: O fato estrutural chave: é **com recurso a você**.

segments.src: Miss payments and the lender can foreclose on the house *and*, in many states, come after you for the shortfall.
segments.tr: Se perder pagamentos, o credor pode executar a hipoteca da casa *e*, em muitos estados, cobrar de você a diferença.

segments.src: Project finance / construction lending (development level).** A developer building something that doesn't exist yet can't pledge a finished building.
segments.tr: Financiamento de projetos / empréstimo para construção (nível de desenvolvimento).** Um incorporador construindo algo que ainda não existe não pode dar um prédio pronto como garantia.

segments.src: So the loan is underwritten against the **project's own projected cash flow**, and it's typically held in a single-purpose entity that owns nothing else.
segments.tr: Portanto, o empréstimo é subscrito com base no **fluxo de caixa projetado do próprio projeto**, e geralmente é mantido em uma entidade de propósito específico que não possui mais nada.

segments.src: Money is released in draws as construction hits milestones, not in one lump sum.
segments.tr: O dinheiro é liberado em parcelas conforme a construção atinge marcos, não em um montante único.

segments.src: It's often non-recourse or limited-recourse — if the project fails, the lender takes the project, not the developer's other assets.
segments.tr: Muitas vezes é sem recurso ou com recurso limitado — se o projeto falhar, o credor toma o projeto, não os outros ativos do incorporador.

segments.src: That's why lenders demand real equity underneath (commonly 30–40% of total cost) and a coverage cushion:
segments.tr: É por isso que os credores exigem capital próprio real por baixo (comumente 30–40% do custo total) e uma margem de cobertura:

segments.src: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service
segments.tr: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service

segments.src: Most lenders want DSCR of at least 1.20–1.25 once the building is leased up.
segments.tr: A maioria dos credores quer um DSCR de pelo menos 1,20–1,25 assim que o prédio estiver locado.

segments.src: Below 1.0 the building doesn't cover its own loan.
segments.tr: Abaixo de 1,0, o prédio não cobre seu próprio empréstimo.

segments.src: REITs (public market level).** A real estate investment trust owns income-producing property (an *equity REIT*) or property loans (a *mortgage REIT*), and sells shares of itself.
segments.tr: REITs (nível de mercado público).** Um fundo de investimento imobiliário (REIT) possui propriedades que geram renda (um *equity REIT*) ou empréstimos imobiliários (um *mortgage REIT*), e vende ações de si mesmo.

segments.src: To keep REIT tax status it must distribute at least **90% of taxable income** to shareholders, hold at least 75% of assets in real estate-type assets, and draw at least 75% of gross income from rents, mortgage interest, and property sales.
segments.tr: Para manter o status fiscal de REIT, ele deve distribuir pelo menos **90% da renda tributável** aos acionistas, manter pelo menos 75% dos ativos em ativos do tipo imobiliário e obter pelo menos 75% da receita bruta de aluguéis, juros de hipotecas e vendas de propriedades.

segments.src: In exchange, it avoids corporate-level tax on distributed income.
segments.tr: Em troca, ele evita impostos corporativos sobre a renda distribuída.

segments.src: Practical translation: high dividend payout, low retained earnings, and dividends that are generally taxed as **ordinary income** rather than at qualified-dividend rates.
segments.tr: Tradução prática: alto pagamento de dividendos, baixos lucros retidos e dividendos que geralmente são tributados como **renda ordinária** em vez de taxas de dividendos qualificados.

segments.src: The thread running through all three is **leverage** — and leverage cuts both directions, which most people only half-remember.
segments.tr: O fio condutor entre os três é a **alavancagem** — e a alavancagem corta para os dois lados, o que a maioria das pessoas só lembra pela metade.

in.title: [Real Estate 101 #11] Hampir Tidak Ada yang Membayar Tunai: Tiga Cara Properti Dibiayai

segments.src: > Real estate runs on borrowed money — a mortgage buys the house you live in, project finance builds the tower downtown, and a REIT lets you own a slice of both for the price of one share.
segments.tr: > Real estate berjalan dengan uang pinjaman — hipotek membeli rumah tempat Anda tinggal, pembiayaan proyek membangun gedung di pusat kota, dan REIT memungkinkan Anda memiliki sebagian dari keduanya dengan harga satu lembar saham.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Real estate is expensive and mostly illiquid, so almost every deal — from a starter home to a $400 million office tower — is a financing deal wearing a building costume.
segments.tr: Real estate itu mahal dan sebagian besar tidak likuid, jadi hampir setiap transaksi — mulai dari rumah pertama hingga gedung perkantoran senilai $400 juta — adalah transaksi pembiayaan yang dibalut dengan bentuk bangunan.

segments.src: There are three main channels, and they differ mainly in **what the lender is actually betting on**.
segments.tr: Ada tiga saluran utama, dan perbedaannya terutama terletak pada **apa yang sebenarnya dipertaruhkan oleh pemberi pinjaman**.

segments.src: The mortgage (household level).** You borrow against a property that already exists.
segments.tr: Hipotek (tingkat rumah tangga).** Anda meminjam dengan jaminan properti yang sudah ada.

segments.src: The lender looks at two things: the collateral and you.
segments.tr: Pemberi pinjaman melihat dua hal: agunan dan diri Anda.

segments.src: LTV = loan amount / property value
segments.tr: LTV = loan amount / property value

segments.src: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income
segments.tr: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income

segments.src: A conventional loan typically wants LTV at or below 80% (that's a 20% down payment) and DTI in the low-to-mid 40s, sometimes up to 50% with strong credit and reserves.
segments.tr: Pinjaman konvensional biasanya menginginkan LTV pada atau di bawah 80% (itu adalah uang muka 20%) dan DTI di angka 40-an rendah hingga menengah, terkadang hingga 50% dengan kredit dan cadangan yang kuat.

segments.src: Go above 80% LTV and you'll usually pay private mortgage insurance (PMI) until you get back down to 80%.
segments.tr: Jika LTV di atas 80%, Anda biasanya akan membayar asuransi hipotek swasta (PMI) sampai LTV Anda kembali ke 80%.

segments.src: The key structural fact: it's **recourse to you**.
segments.tr: Fakta struktural kuncinya: ini adalah **tanggung jawab pribadi Anda (recourse to you)**.

segments.src: Miss payments and the lender can foreclose on the house *and*, in many states, come after you for the shortfall.
segments.tr: Jika gagal bayar, pemberi pinjaman dapat menyita rumah tersebut *dan*, di banyak negara bagian, mengejar Anda untuk menutupi kekurangannya.

segments.src: Project finance / construction lending (development level).** A developer building something that doesn't exist yet can't pledge a finished building.
segments.tr: Pembiayaan proyek / pinjaman konstruksi (tingkat pengembangan).** Pengembang yang membangun sesuatu yang belum ada tidak dapat menjaminkan bangunan yang sudah jadi.

segments.src: So the loan is underwritten against the **project's own projected cash flow**, and it's typically held in a single-purpose entity that owns nothing else.
segments.tr: Jadi, pinjaman dijamin berdasarkan **proyeksi arus kas proyek itu sendiri**, dan biasanya dipegang dalam entitas tujuan khusus (special-purpose entity) yang tidak memiliki aset lain.

segments.src: Money is released in draws as construction hits milestones, not in one lump sum.
segments.tr: Uang dicairkan secara bertahap saat konstruksi mencapai tonggak pencapaian, bukan dalam satu jumlah sekaligus.

segments.src: It's often non-recourse or limited-recourse — if the project fails, the lender takes the project, not the developer's other assets.
segments.tr: Ini sering kali bersifat non-recourse atau recourse terbatas — jika proyek gagal, pemberi pinjaman mengambil proyek tersebut, bukan aset pengembang lainnya.

segments.src: That's why lenders demand real equity underneath (commonly 30–40% of total cost) and a coverage cushion:
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya pemberi pinjaman menuntut ekuitas nyata di bawahnya (biasanya 30–40% dari total biaya) dan bantalan cakupan:

segments.src: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service
segments.tr: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service

segments.src: Most lenders want DSCR of at least 1.20–1.25 once the building is leased up.
segments.tr: Kebanyakan pemberi pinjaman menginginkan DSCR setidaknya 1,20–1,25 setelah bangunan disewakan.

segments.src: Below 1.0 the building doesn't cover its own loan.
segments.tr: Di bawah 1,0, bangunan tersebut tidak dapat menutupi pinjamannya sendiri.

segments.src: REITs (public market level).** A real estate investment trust owns income-producing property (an *equity REIT*) or property loans (a *mortgage REIT*), and sells shares of itself.
segments.tr: REIT (tingkat pasar publik).** Real estate investment trust memiliki properti yang menghasilkan pendapatan (*equity REIT*) atau pinjaman properti (*mortgage REIT*), dan menjual saham dirinya sendiri.

segments.src: To keep REIT tax status it must distribute at least **90% of taxable income** to shareholders, hold at least 75% of assets in real estate-type assets, and draw at least 75% of gross income from rents, mortgage interest, and property sales.
segments.tr: Untuk mempertahankan status pajak REIT, perusahaan harus mendistribusikan setidaknya **90% dari pendapatan kena pajak** kepada pemegang saham, menahan setidaknya 75% aset dalam bentuk aset real estate, dan memperoleh setidaknya 75% pendapatan kotor dari sewa, bunga hipotek, dan penjualan properti.

segments.src: In exchange, it avoids corporate-level tax on distributed income.
segments.tr: Sebagai gantinya, perusahaan menghindari pajak tingkat korporasi atas pendapatan yang didistribusikan.

segments.src: Practical translation: high dividend payout, low retained earnings, and dividends that are generally taxed as **ordinary income** rather than at qualified-dividend rates.
segments.tr: Terjemahan praktisnya: pembayaran dividen tinggi, laba ditahan rendah, dan dividen yang umumnya dikenakan pajak sebagai **pendapatan biasa** alih-alih tarif dividen yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: The thread running through all three is **leverage** — and leverage cuts both directions, which most people only half-remember.
segments.tr: Benang merah yang menghubungkan ketiganya adalah **leverage** — dan leverage bekerja dua arah, yang sering kali hanya diingat setengah oleh kebanyakan orang.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Say you're buying a $350,000 house in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: Katakanlah Anda membeli rumah seharga $350.000 di Columbus, Ohio.

segments.src: You put 20% down ($70,000) and borrow $280,000 on a 30-year fixed.
segments.tr: Anda membayar uang muka 20% ($70.000) dan meminjam $280.000 dengan bunga tetap 30 tahun.

segments.src: At 6.5%, principal and interest run about **$1,770 a month** — before taxes, insurance, and any HOA.
segments.tr: Pada bunga 6,5%, pokok dan bunga berjumlah sekitar **$1.770 per bulan** — sebelum pajak, asuransi, dan biaya HOA apa pun.

segments.src: Over the full 30 years you'd pay roughly **$357,000 in interest**, more than the amount you borrowed.
segments.tr: Selama 30 tahun penuh, Anda akan membayar sekitar **$357.000 dalam bentuk bunga**, lebih besar dari jumlah yang Anda pinjam.

segments.src: That's the price of not waiting 15 years to save cash.
segments.tr: Itulah harga yang harus dibayar karena tidak menunggu 15 tahun untuk menabung uang tunai.

segments.src: Now the leverage math.
segments.tr: Sekarang mari kita hitung leverage-nya.

segments.src: Your $70,000 controls a $350,000 asset — 5x.
segments.tr: Uang $70.000 Anda mengendalikan aset senilai $350.000 — 5x lipat.

segments.src: If the house appreciates 10% to $385,000, your equity goes from $70,000 to $105,000: a **50% gain**.
segments.tr: Jika harga rumah naik 10% menjadi $385.000, ekuitas Anda naik dari $70.000 menjadi $105.000: **keuntungan 50%**.

segments.src: If it drops 10% to $315,000, your equity falls to $35,000: a **50% loss**.
segments.tr: Jika turun 10% menjadi $315.000, ekuitas Anda turun menjadi $35.000: **kerugian 50%**.

segments.src: Same 10% move, five times the impact on your money.
segments.tr: Pergerakan 10% yang sama, memberikan dampak lima kali lipat pada uang Anda.

segments.src: Nothing about the house changed; the loan did that.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang berubah pada rumahnya; pinjamanlah yang menyebabkan hal itu.

segments.src: Two blocks away, a developer is putting up a 200-unit apartment building.
segments.tr: Dua blok dari sana, seorang pengembang sedang mendirikan gedung apartemen 200 unit.

segments.src: Total cost: $60 million.
segments.tr: Total biaya: $60 juta.

segments.src: A bank lends $40 million (about 65% loan-to-cost), released in draws as the foundation, frame, and finishes get completed; the developer brings $20 million of equity and preferred capital.
segments.tr: Bank meminjamkan $40 juta (sekitar 65% loan-to-cost), dicairkan secara bertahap saat fondasi, kerangka, dan penyelesaian selesai; pengembang membawa $20 juta ekuitas dan modal preferen.

segments.src: Nobody's personal house backs this.
segments.tr: Tidak ada rumah pribadi siapa pun yang menjamin ini.

segments.src: When the building stabilizes and throws off, say, $3.9 million of net operating income against roughly $2.9 million of annual debt service, DSCR lands near 1.35 — comfortable.
segments.tr: Ketika bangunan stabil dan menghasilkan, katakanlah, $3,9 juta pendapatan operasional bersih terhadap sekitar $2,9 juta layanan utang tahunan, DSCR berada di angka 1,35 — cukup nyaman.

segments.src: At a 6% cap rate that NOI values the building around $65 million, so a $60 million cost turns into roughly $5 million of gain on $20 million of equity.
segments.tr: Pada tingkat kapitalisasi (cap rate) 6%, NOI tersebut menilai bangunan sekitar $65 juta, jadi biaya $60 juta berubah menjadi keuntungan sekitar $5 juta dari $20 juta ekuitas.

segments.src: Illustrative, not typical: a nine-month construction delay, a rate move, or lease-up at 88% instead of 95% can erase that spread entirely.
segments.tr: Ini hanya ilustrasi, bukan hal yang umum: penundaan konstruksi selama sembilan bulan, perubahan suku bunga, atau tingkat sewa 88% alih-alih 95% dapat menghapus keuntungan tersebut sepenuhnya.

segments.src: And who buys that stabilized building?
segments.tr: Dan siapa yang membeli bangunan yang sudah stabil itu?

segments.src: Often a REIT — one of the roughly 200 publicly traded U.S.
segments.tr: Seringkali REIT — salah satu dari sekitar 200 perusahaan publik AS.

segments.src: REITs listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq.
segments.tr: REIT yang terdaftar di NYSE dan Nasdaq.

segments.src: Which means the same apartment complex you drive past is something you can own a sliver of from a brokerage account for the price of one share, collecting your cut of the rent as a quarterly dividend, without ever fixing a water heater.
segments.tr: Yang berarti kompleks apartemen yang Anda lewati setiap hari adalah sesuatu yang bisa Anda miliki sebagian kecilnya dari akun broker seharga satu lembar saham, mengumpulkan bagian sewa Anda sebagai dividen triwulanan, tanpa perlu memperbaiki pemanas air sendiri.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. A mortgage lends against an existing property and against **you** (LTV + DTI, usually with recourse); project finance lends against a **future building's cash flow**, held in its own entity, usually with limited recourse and a DSCR test.
segments.tr: 1. Hipotek meminjamkan dengan jaminan properti yang ada dan **Anda** (LTV + DTI, biasanya dengan recourse); pembiayaan proyek meminjamkan dengan jaminan **arus kas bangunan masa depan**, dipegang dalam entitasnya sendiri, biasanya dengan recourse terbatas dan uji DSCR.

segments.src: 2. Leverage multiplies percentage returns in both directions — 20% down means a 10% price move becomes a 50% move in your equity.
segments.tr: 2. Leverage melipatgandakan persentase keuntungan ke kedua arah — uang muka 20% berarti pergerakan harga 10% menjadi pergerakan 50% dalam ekuitas Anda.

segments.src: 3. A REIT converts illiquid buildings into tradable shares; the 90% distribution requirement is why REITs pay big dividends and why those dividends are generally taxed as ordinary income.
segments.tr: 3. REIT mengubah bangunan yang tidak likuid menjadi saham yang dapat diperdagangkan; persyaratan distribusi 90% adalah alasan mengapa REIT membayar dividen besar dan mengapa dividen tersebut umumnya dikenakan pajak sebagai pendapatan biasa.

ja.title: [不動産101 #11] 現金で支払う人はほとんどいない：不動産資金調達の3つの方法

segments.src: > Real estate runs on borrowed money — a mortgage buys the house you live in, project finance builds the tower downtown, and a REIT lets you own a slice of both for the price of one share.
segments.tr: > 不動産は借入金で動いています。住宅ローンはあなたが住む家を買い、プロジェクトファイナンスはダウンタウンのタワーを建設し、REIT（不動産投資信託）は1株分の価格でその両方の断片を所有することを可能にします。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: Real estate is expensive and mostly illiquid, so almost every deal — from a starter home to a $400 million office tower — is a financing deal wearing a building costume.
segments.tr: 不動産は高額で流動性が低いため、最初のマイホームから4億ドルのオフィスビルに至るまで、ほぼすべての取引が「建物の仮装をした資金調達取引」です。

segments.src: There are three main channels, and they differ mainly in **what the lender is actually betting on**.
segments.tr: 主なチャネルは3つあり、それらは主に**貸し手が実際に何に賭けているか**という点で異なります。

segments.src: The mortgage (household level).** You borrow against a property that already exists.
segments.tr: 住宅ローン（家計レベル）。** すでに存在する物件を担保に借入を行います。

segments.src: The lender looks at two things: the collateral and you.
segments.tr: 貸し手は、担保とあなた自身の2点を見ます。

segments.src: LTV = loan amount / property value
segments.tr: LTV = loan amount / property value

segments.src: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income
segments.tr: DTI = monthly debt payments / gross monthly income

segments.src: A conventional loan typically wants LTV at or below 80% (that's a 20% down payment) and DTI in the low-to-mid 40s, sometimes up to 50% with strong credit and reserves.
segments.tr: 一般的なローンでは、LTV（借入比率）が80%以下（つまり頭金20%）、DTI（負債比率）が40%台前半から半ばであることが求められます。強力な信用力と予備資金があれば、50%まで許容されることもあります。

segments.src: Go above 80% LTV and you'll usually pay private mortgage insurance (PMI) until you get back down to 80%.
segments.tr: LTVが80%を超えると、通常は80%に戻るまで民間住宅ローン保険（PMI）を支払うことになります。

segments.src: The key structural fact: it's **recourse to you**.
segments.tr: 構造上の重要な事実は、それが**あなたへの遡及権（リコース）**を伴うということです。

segments.src: Miss payments and the lender can foreclose on the house *and*, in many states, come after you for the shortfall.
segments.tr: 支払いが滞れば、貸し手は住宅を差し押さえることができ、*さらに*多くの州では、不足分についてあなたに請求することができます。

segments.src: Project finance / construction lending (development level).** A developer building something that doesn't exist yet can't pledge a finished building.
segments.tr: プロジェクトファイナンス / 建設融資（開発レベル）。** まだ存在しない建物を建設する開発者は、完成した建物を担保にすることはできません。

segments.src: So the loan is underwritten against the **project's own projected cash flow**, and it's typically held in a single-purpose entity that owns nothing else.
segments.tr: そのため、ローンは**プロジェクト自身の予測キャッシュフロー**に基づいて審査され、通常はそれ以外の資産を持たない特定目的会社（SPC）で保有されます。

segments.src: Money is released in draws as construction hits milestones, not in one lump sum.
segments.tr: 資金は一括ではなく、建設の進捗に応じて段階的に放出されます。

segments.src: It's often non-recourse or limited-recourse — if the project fails, the lender takes the project, not the developer's other assets.
segments.tr: これは多くの場合、ノンリコース（非遡及型）または限定的リコースです。プロジェクトが失敗しても、貸し手はプロジェクトを差し押さえるだけで、開発者の他の資産には手を出しません。

segments.src: That's why lenders demand real equity underneath (commonly 30–40% of total cost) and a coverage cushion:
segments.tr: だからこそ、貸し手は実質的な自己資本（通常は総コストの30〜40%）と、カバレッジのクッションを要求するのです。

segments.src: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service
segments.tr: DSCR = net operating income / annual debt service

segments.src: Most lenders want DSCR of at least 1.20–1.25 once the building is leased up.
segments.tr: ほとんどの貸し手は、建物が満室になった時点でDSCR（借入元利金償還余裕率）が少なくとも1.20〜1.25であることを望みます。

segments.src: Below 1.0 the building doesn't cover its own loan.
segments.tr: 1.0を下回ると、その建物は自身のローンを返済できません。

segments.src: REITs (public market level).** A real estate investment trust owns income-producing property (an *equity REIT*) or property loans (a *mortgage REIT*), and sells shares of itself.
segments.tr: REIT（公開市場レベル）。** 不動産投資信託は、収益を生む不動産（*エクイティREIT*）や不動産ローン（*モーゲージREIT*）を所有し、自身の株式を販売します。

segments.src: To keep REIT tax status it must distribute at least **90% of taxable income** to shareholders, hold at least 75% of assets in real estate-type assets, and draw at least 75% of gross income from rents, mortgage interest, and property sales.
segments.tr: REITの税制優遇措置を維持するには、**課税所得の少なくとも90%**を株主に分配し、資産の少なくとも75%を不動産関連資産で保有し、総収入の少なくとも75%を賃料、住宅ローン利息、不動産売却から得る必要があります。

segments.src: In exchange, it avoids corporate-level tax on distributed income.
segments.tr: その代わりとして、分配された所得に対する法人レベルの課税が免除されます。

segments.src: Practical translation: high dividend payout, low retained earnings, and dividends that are generally taxed as **ordinary income** rather than at qualified-dividend rates.
segments.tr: 実務上の意味は、高い配当利回り、低い内部留保、そして配当金は一般的に適格配当税率ではなく**総合課税（通常の所得）**として課税されるということです。

segments.src: The thread running through all three is **leverage** — and leverage cuts both directions, which most people only half-remember.
segments.tr: これら3つすべてに共通する糸は**レバレッジ**です。そしてレバレッジは両刃の剣ですが、ほとんどの人はその半分しか覚えていません。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活では

segments.src: Say you're buying a $350,000 house in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: オハイオ州コロンバスで35万ドルの住宅を購入するとします。

segments.src: You put 20% down ($70,000) and borrow $280,000 on a 30-year fixed.
segments.tr: 20%の頭金（7万ドル）を支払い、30年固定金利で28万ドルを借ります。

segments.src: At 6.5%, principal and interest run about **$1,770 a month** — before taxes, insurance, and any HOA.
segments.tr: 金利6.5%の場合、元利金は**月額約1,770ドル**になります（税金、保険、HOA管理費は含まず）。

segments.src: Over the full 30 years you'd pay roughly **$357,000 in interest**, more than the amount you borrowed.
segments.tr: 30年間で支払う利息は約**35万7,000ドル**となり、借りた金額よりも多くなります。

segments.src: That's the price of not waiting 15 years to save cash.
segments.tr: それが、現金を貯めるために15年待たないことの代償です。

segments.src: Now the leverage math.
segments.tr: さて、レバレッジの計算です。

segments.src: Your $70,000 controls a $350,000 asset — 5x.
segments.tr: あなたの7万ドルが35万ドルの資産をコントロールしています。つまり5倍です。

segments.src: If the house appreciates 10% to $385,000, your equity goes from $70,000 to $105,000: a **50% gain**.
segments.tr: もし住宅価格が10%上昇して38万5,000ドルになれば、あなたの自己資本は7万ドルから10万5,000ドルになり、**50%の利益**となります。

segments.src: If it drops 10% to $315,000, your equity falls to $35,000: a **50% loss**.
segments.tr: もし10%下落して31万5,000ドルになれば、あなたの自己資本は3万5,000ドルに減り、**50%の損失**となります。

segments.src: Same 10% move, five times the impact on your money.
segments.tr: 同じ10%の変動でも、資金への影響は5倍です。

segments.src: Nothing about the house changed; the loan did that.
segments.tr: 住宅自体は何も変わっていませんが、ローンがそれを引き起こしたのです。

segments.src: Two blocks away, a developer is putting up a 200-unit apartment building.
segments.tr: 2ブロック先では、開発者が200戸のアパートを建設しています。

segments.src: Total cost: $60 million.
segments.tr: 総コストは6,000万ドルです。

segments.src: A bank lends $40 million (about 65% loan-to-cost), released in draws as the foundation, frame, and finishes get completed; the developer brings $20 million of equity and preferred capital.
segments.tr: 銀行が4,000万ドル（融資比率約65%）を貸し出し、基礎、骨組み、仕上げの完了に合わせて段階的に放出されます。開発者は2,000万ドルの自己資本と優先資本を用意します。

segments.src: Nobody's personal house backs this.
segments.tr: 個人の住宅がこれを裏付けているわけではありません。

segments.src: When the building stabilizes and throws off, say, $3.9 million of net operating income against roughly $2.9 million of annual debt service, DSCR lands near 1.35 — comfortable.
segments.tr: 建物が安定稼働し、年間約290万ドルの債務返済に対して、例えば390万ドルの純営業利益（NOI）を生み出すようになれば、DSCRは約1.35となり、余裕があります。

segments.src: At a 6% cap rate that NOI values the building around $65 million, so a $60 million cost turns into roughly $5 million of gain on $20 million of equity.
segments.tr: キャップレート（還元利回り）6%で計算すると、そのNOIは建物を約6,500万ドルの価値と評価するため、6,000万ドルのコストが2,000万ドルの自己資本に対して約500万ドルの利益に変わります。

segments.src: Illustrative, not typical: a nine-month construction delay, a rate move, or lease-up at 88% instead of 95% can erase that spread entirely.
segments.tr: これは例示であり、典型的ではありません。9ヶ月の工期遅延、金利変動、または95%ではなく88%の入居率で安定化した場合、そのスプレッドは完全に消滅する可能性があります。

segments.src: And who buys that stabilized building?
segments.tr: そして、その安定した建物を誰が買うのでしょうか？

segments.src: Often a REIT — one of the roughly 200 publicly traded U.S.
segments.tr: 多くの場合、REITです。米国で上場している約200のREITのうちの1つです。

segments.src: REITs listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq.
segments.tr: ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）やナスダックに上場しているREITです。

segments.src: Which means the same apartment complex you drive past is something you can own a sliver of from a brokerage account for the price of one share, collecting your cut of the rent as a quarterly dividend, without ever fixing a water heater.
segments.tr: つまり、あなたが車で通り過ぎるそのアパートは、証券口座から1株分の価格でその一部を所有でき、給湯器の修理をすることなく、四半期ごとの配当として賃料の分け前を受け取ることができるものなのです。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3行まとめ

segments.src: 1. A mortgage lends against an existing property and against **you** (LTV + DTI, usually with recourse); project finance lends against a **future building's cash flow**, held in its own entity, usually with limited recourse and a DSCR test.
segments.tr: 1. 住宅ローンは既存の物件と**あなた自身**を担保に貸し出され（LTV + DTI、通常は遡及権あり）、プロジェクトファイナンスは**将来の建物のキャッシュフロー**を担保に、独立した事業体で保有され、通常は限定的遡及権とDSCRテストを伴います。

segments.src: 2. Leverage multiplies percentage returns in both directions — 20% down means a 10% price move becomes a 50% move in your equity.
segments.tr: 2. レバレッジはパーセンテージのリターンを両方向に増幅させます。頭金20%の場合、価格が10%動くと自己資本は50%動くことになります。

segments.src: 3. A REIT converts illiquid buildings into tradable shares; the 90% distribution requirement is why REITs pay big dividends and why those dividends are generally taxed as ordinary income.
segments.tr: 3. REITは流動性の低い建物を取引可能な株式に変換します。90%の分配要件があるため、REITは高配当であり、その配当は一般的に総合課税として課税されます。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ セルフクイズ

segments.src: **1.** You buy a $400,000 property with a $320,000 loan.
segments.tr: **1.** 40万ドルの物件を32万ドルのローンで購入します。

segments.src: What is the LTV, and would you typically owe PMI on a conventional loan?
segments.tr: LTVはいくらで、一般的なローンでPMIを支払う必要がありますか？

segments.src: (a) 80%, no PMI   (b) 80%, PMI required   (c) 125%, no PMI   (d) 20%, PMI required
segments.tr: (a) 80%、PMI不要   (b) 80%、PMI必要   (c) 125%、PMI不要   (d) 20%、PMI必要

segments.src: True or False:** A REIT must distribute at least 90% of its taxable income to shareholders to maintain REIT tax status.
segments.tr: 正誤問題：** REITはREITの税制ステータスを維持するために、課税所得の少なくとも90%を株主に分配しなければなりません。

segments.src: **3.** A project has $2.4 million in net operating income and $2.0 million in annual debt service.
segments.tr: **3.** あるプロジェクトの純営業利益は240万ドル、年間債務返済額は200万ドルです。

segments.src: Which statement is correct?
segments.tr: 正しい記述はどれですか？

segments.src: (a) DSCR is 0.83 — the project cannot cover its debt
segments.tr: (a) DSCRは0.83 — プロジェクトは債務をカバーできない

segments.src: (b) DSCR is 1.20 — the project covers its debt with a 20% cushion
segments.tr: (b) DSCRは1.20 — プロジェクトは20%の余裕を持って債務をカバーしている

segments.src: (c) DSCR is 4.4 — this is the cap rate
segments.tr: (c) DSCRは4.4 — これがキャップレートである

segments.src: (d) DSCR cannot be calculated without the purchase price
segments.tr: (d) DSCRは購入価格なしでは計算できない

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value)** — Loan amount divided by property value; the lender's primary measure of collateral cushion.
segments.tr: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value / 借入比率)** — ローン額を物件価格で割ったもの。貸し手が担保の余裕を測る主要な指標。

segments.src: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — Net operating income divided by annual debt service; below 1.0 the property can't pay its own loan.
segments.tr: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio / 借入元利金償還余裕率)** — 純営業利益を年間債務返済額で割ったもの。1.0を下回ると、物件は自身のローンを支払えない。

segments.src: - **Non-recourse loan** — A loan where the lender's remedy on default is limited to the pledged property, not the borrower's other assets.
segments.tr: - **ノンリコースローン（非遡及型ローン）** — デフォルト時の貸し手の救済措置が、担保物件に限定され、借り手の他の資産には及ばないローン。

segments.src: - **Takeout (permanent) loan** — Long-term financing that replaces a short-term construction loan once the building is completed and leased.
segments.tr: - **テイクアウトローン（恒久融資）** — 建物が完成し賃貸が開始された後に、短期の建設ローンを置き換える長期融資。

segments.src: - **Cap rate** — Net operating income divided by property price; a rough yield measure used to value income property (`Cap rate = NOI / price`).
segments.tr: - **キャップレート（還元利回り）** — 純営業利益を物件価格で割ったもの。収益物件を評価するために使用される大まかな利回り指標（`Cap rate = NOI / price`）。

segments.src: - **REIT** — A company owning income-producing real estate or real estate debt that avoids corporate-level tax by distributing at least 90% of taxable income.
segments.tr: - **REIT** — 収益を生む不動産や不動産債権を所有する会社。課税所得の少なくとも90%を分配することで、法人レベルの税金を回避する。

segments.src: *Answers: **1.
(a)** — $320,000 / $400,000 = 80% LTV, which is exactly the conventional threshold, so PMI is generally not required; PMI kicks in above 80% LTV (less than 20% down).
segments.tr: (a)** — 32万ドル / 40万ドル = 80% LTV。これは一般的な基準値であるため、通常PMIは不要です。PMIはLTVが80%を超える（頭金が20%未満）場合に発生します。

segments.src: True** — the 90% distribution requirement is a core REIT qualification test, alongside the 75% asset and 75% income tests.
segments.tr: 正** — 90%の分配要件は、75%の資産要件および75%の所得要件と並んで、REITの主要な資格試験です。

segments.src: (b)** — $2.4M / $2.0M = 1.20 DSCR, meaning income exceeds debt payments by 20%; most lenders set a floor around 1.20–1.25.
segments.tr: (b)** — 240万ドル / 200万ドル = 1.20 DSCR。これは収入が債務返済額を20%上回っていることを意味します。ほとんどの貸し手は1.20〜1.25程度を下限に設定しています。

segments.src: Cap rate is a separate calculation and needs the price.*
segments.tr: キャップレートは別の計算であり、価格が必要です。*

segments.tr: Unter 1,0 deckt das Gebäude seinen eigenen Kredit nicht ab.

segments.src: REITs (public market level).** A real estate investment trust owns income-producing property (an *equity REIT*) or property loans (a *mortgage REIT*), and sells shares of itself.
segments.tr: REITs (Ebene des öffentlichen Marktes).** Ein Real Estate Investment Trust besitzt ertragsbringende Immobilien (ein *Equity REIT*) oder Immobilienkredite (ein *Mortgage REIT*) und verkauft Anteile an sich selbst.

segments.src: To keep REIT tax status it must distribute at least **90% of taxable income** to shareholders, hold at least 75% of assets in real estate-type assets, and draw at least 75% of gross income from rents, mortgage interest, and property sales.
segments.tr: Um den REIT-Steuerstatus zu behalten, muss er mindestens **90% des steuerpflichtigen Einkommens** an die Aktionäre ausschütten, mindestens 75% der Vermögenswerte in immobilienähnlichen Anlagen halten und mindestens 75% des Bruttoeinkommens aus Mieten, Hypothekenzinsen und Immobilienverkäufen beziehen.

segments.src: In exchange, it avoids corporate-level tax on distributed income.
segments.tr: Im Gegenzug vermeidet er die Körperschaftssteuer auf ausgeschüttete Erträge.

segments.src: Practical translation: high dividend payout, low retained earnings, and dividends that are generally taxed as **ordinary income** rather than at qualified-dividend rates.
segments.tr: Praktische Übersetzung: hohe Dividendenausschüttung, niedrige einbehaltene Gewinne und Dividenden, die im Allgemeinen als **ordentliches Einkommen** besteuert werden und nicht mit den Sätzen für qualifizierte Dividenden.

segments.src: The thread running through all three is **leverage** — and leverage cuts both directions, which most people only half-remember.
segments.tr: Der rote Faden, der sich durch alle drei zieht, ist **Leverage** (Hebelwirkung) – und Leverage wirkt in beide Richtungen, was die meisten Leute nur halb im Gedächtnis haben.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Say you're buying a $350,000 house in Columbus, Ohio.
segments.tr: Nehmen wir an, Sie kaufen ein Haus für 350.000 $ in Columbus, Ohio.

segments.src: You put 20% down ($70,000) and borrow $280,000 on a 30-year fixed.
segments.tr: Sie zahlen 20% an (70.000 $) und leihen sich 280.000 $ mit einer 30-jährigen Festzinsbindung.

segments.src: At 6.5%, principal and interest run about **$1,770 a month** — before taxes, insurance, and any HOA.
segments.tr: Bei 6,5% belaufen sich Tilgung und Zinsen auf etwa **1.770 $ pro Monat** – vor Steuern, Versicherungen und etwaigen HOA-Gebühren.

segments.src: Over the full 30 years you'd pay roughly **$357,000 in interest**, more than the amount you borrowed.
segments.tr: Über die vollen 30 Jahre würden Sie etwa **357.000 $ an Zinsen** zahlen, mehr als den Betrag, den Sie geliehen haben.

segments.src: That's the price of not waiting 15 years to save cash.
segments.tr: Das ist der Preis dafür, nicht 15 Jahre zu warten, um Bargeld zu sparen.

segments.src: Now the leverage math.
segments.tr: Nun zur Leverage-Rechnung.

segments.src: Your $70,000 controls a $350,000 asset — 5x.
segments.tr: Ihre 70.000 $ kontrollieren einen Vermögenswert von 350.000 $ – das ist das 5-Fache.

segments.src: If the house appreciates 10% to $385,000, your equity goes from $70,000 to $105,000: a **50% gain**.
segments.tr: Wenn das Haus um 10% auf 385.000 $ an Wert gewinnt, steigt Ihr Eigenkapital von 70.000 $ auf 105.000 $: ein **Gewinn von 50%**.

segments.src: If it drops 10% to $315,000, your equity falls to $35,000: a **50% loss**.
segments.tr: Wenn es um 10% auf 315.000 $ fällt, sinkt Ihr Eigenkapital auf 35.000 $: ein **Verlust von 50%**.

segments.src: Same 10% move, five times the impact on your money.
segments.tr: Dieselbe 10%-Bewegung, die fünffache Auswirkung auf Ihr Geld.

segments.src: Nothing about the house changed; the loan did that.
segments.tr: An dem Haus hat sich nichts geändert; das hat der Kredit bewirkt.

segments.src: Two blocks away, a developer is putting up a 200-unit apartment building.
segments.tr: Zwei Blocks weiter baut ein Bauträger ein Apartmentgebäude mit 200 Einheiten.

segments.src: Total cost: $60 million.
segments.tr: Gesamtkosten: 60 Millionen $.

segments.src: A bank lends $40 million (about 65% loan-to-cost), released in draws as the foundation, frame, and finishes get completed; the developer brings $20 million of equity and preferred capital.
segments.tr: Eine Bank leiht 40 Millionen $ (etwa 65% Loan-to-Cost), die in Tranchen ausgezahlt werden, wenn Fundament, Rahmen und Ausbau fertiggestellt sind; der Bauträger bringt 20 Millionen $ an Eigenkapital und Vorzugskapital ein.

segments.src: Nobody's personal house backs this.
segments.tr: Niemandes persönliches Haus bürgt hierfür.

segments.src: When the building stabilizes and throws off, say, $3.9 million of net operating income against roughly $2.9 million of annual debt service, DSCR lands near 1.35 — comfortable.
segments.tr: Wenn das Gebäude stabilisiert ist und beispielsweise 3,9 Millionen Dollar an Nettobetriebseinkommen (NOI) gegenüber etwa 2,9 Millionen Dollar an jährlichem Schuldendienst abwirft, liegt der DSCR bei etwa 1,35 — ein komfortabler Wert.

segments.src: At a 6% cap rate that NOI values the building around $65 million, so a $60 million cost turns into roughly $5 million of gain on $20 million of equity.
segments.tr: Bei einem Kapitalisierungssatz (Cap Rate) von 6 % bewertet dieses NOI das Gebäude mit etwa 65 Millionen Dollar, sodass aus 60 Millionen Dollar Kosten ein Gewinn von etwa 5 Millionen Dollar bei 20 Millionen Dollar Eigenkapital wird.

segments.src: Illustrative, not typical: a nine-month construction delay, a rate move, or lease-up at 88% instead of 95% can erase that spread entirely.
segments.tr: Illustrativ, nicht typisch: Eine Bauverzögerung von neun Monaten, eine Zinsänderung oder eine Vermietungsquote von 88 % statt 95 % können diese Spanne vollständig zunichtemachen.

segments.src: And who buys that stabilized building?
segments.tr: Und wer kauft dieses stabilisierte Gebäude?

segments.src: Often a REIT — one of the roughly 200 publicly traded U.S.
segments.tr: Oft ein REIT — einer der etwa 200 börsennotierten US-amerikanischen

segments.src: REITs listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq.
segments.tr: REITs, die an der NYSE und Nasdaq gelistet sind.

segments.src: Which means the same apartment complex you drive past is something you can own a sliver of from a brokerage account for the price of one share, collecting your cut of the rent as a quarterly dividend, without ever fixing a water heater.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, dass der Apartmentkomplex, an dem Sie vorbeifahren, etwas ist, von dem Sie über ein Brokerkonto zum Preis einer Aktie einen kleinen Teil besitzen können, wobei Sie Ihren Anteil an der Miete als vierteljährliche Dividende erhalten, ohne jemals einen Warmwasserbereiter reparieren zu müssen.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3-Zeilen-Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. A mortgage lends against an existing property and against **you** (LTV + DTI, usually with recourse); project finance lends against a **future building's cash flow**, held in its own entity, usually with limited recourse and a DSCR test.
segments.tr: 1. Eine Hypothek wird gegen eine bestehende Immobilie und gegen **Sie** vergeben (LTV + DTI, normalerweise mit Rückgriff); Projektfinanzierungen werden gegen den **zukünftigen Cashflow eines Gebäudes** vergeben, der in einer eigenen Einheit gehalten wird, normalerweise mit begrenztem Rückgriff und einem DSCR-Test.

segments.src: 2. Leverage multiplies percentage returns in both directions — 20% down means a 10% price move becomes a 50% move in your equity.
segments.tr: 2. Hebelwirkung multipliziert prozentuale Renditen in beide Richtungen — 20 % Anzahlung bedeuten, dass eine Preisbewegung von 10 % zu einer Bewegung von 50 % bei Ihrem Eigenkapital wird.

segments.src: 3. A REIT converts illiquid buildings into tradable shares; the 90% distribution requirement is why REITs pay big dividends and why those dividends are generally taxed as ordinary income.
segments.tr: 3. Ein REIT wandelt illiquide Gebäude in handelbare Aktien um; die Ausschüttungspflicht von 90 % ist der Grund, warum REITs hohe Dividenden zahlen und warum diese Dividenden im Allgemeinen als ordentliches Einkommen besteuert werden.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Selbsttest

segments.tr: (b) DSCR ist 1,20 — das Projekt deckt seine Schulden mit einem Puffer von 20 %

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Begriffe von heute

segments.src: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value)** — Loan amount divided by property value; the lender's primary measure of collateral cushion.
segments.tr: - **LTV (Loan-to-Value)** — Kreditbetrag geteilt durch Immobilienwert; das primäre Maß des Kreditgebers für den Sicherheitenpuffer.

segments.src: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — Net operating income divided by annual debt service; below 1.0 the property can't pay its own loan.
segments.tr: - **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio)** — Nettobetriebseinkommen geteilt durch jährlichen Schuldendienst; unter 1,0 kann die Immobilie ihren eigenen Kredit nicht bedienen.

segments.src: - **Non-recourse loan** — A loan where the lender's remedy on default is limited to the pledged property, not the borrower's other assets.
segments.tr: - **Non-recourse loan (Nicht-regressfähiges Darlehen)** — Ein Darlehen, bei dem sich der Regress des Kreditgebers im Falle eines Ausfalls auf die verpfändete Immobilie beschränkt, nicht auf andere Vermögenswerte des Kreditnehmers.

segments.src: - **Takeout (permanent) loan** — Long-term financing that replaces a short-term construction loan once the building is completed and leased.
segments.tr: - **Takeout (permanent) loan (Endfinanzierung)** — Langfristige Finanzierung, die ein kurzfristiges Baudarlehen ersetzt, sobald das Gebäude fertiggestellt und vermietet ist.

segments.src: - **Cap rate** — Net operating income divided by property price; a rough yield measure used to value income property (`Cap rate = NOI / price`).
segments.tr: - **Cap rate (Kapitalisierungssatz)** — Nettobetriebseinkommen geteilt durch Immobilienpreis; ein grobes Renditemaß zur Bewertung von Renditeimmobilien (`Cap rate = NOI / price`).

segments.src: - **REIT** — A company owning income-producing real estate or real estate debt that avoids corporate-level tax by distributing at least 90% of taxable income.
segments.tr: - **REIT** — Ein Unternehmen, das einkommensgenerierende Immobilien oder Immobilienschulden besitzt und die Steuer auf Unternehmensebene vermeidet, indem es mindestens 90 % des steuerpflichtigen Einkommens ausschüttet.

segments.tr: *Antworten: **1.

segments.src: True** — the 90% distribution requirement is a core REIT qualification test, alongside the 75% asset and 75% income tests.
segments.tr: Richtig** — die 90 % Ausschüttungspflicht ist ein zentraler REIT-Qualifikationstest, neben den 75 % Vermögens- und 75 % Einkommenstests.

segments.tr: (b)** — 2,4 Mio. $ / 2,0 Mio. $ = 1,20 DSCR, was bedeutet, dass das Einkommen die Schuldentilgungen um 20 % übersteigt; die meisten Kreditgeber setzen eine Untergrenze von etwa 1,20–1,25.
